summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K on April 29, 2026, to announce the dates for its first quarter 2026 earnings release and conference call. The earnings will be released after market close on May 12, 2026, followed by a virtual conference call on May 13, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings schedule announcement and does not involve any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other corporate event. No deal terms are present, and there are no actionable special-situation elements for investors.
